  father / dad       — ota
  mother / mum       — ona
  parents            — ota-ona
  grandfather / grandad — bobo
  grandmother / granny  — buvi

  sister             — opa yoki singil
  son                — o'g'il
  daughter           — qiz

Kerak bo'lsa 'older brother' (katta aka) yoki 'younger brother' (uka)
deb aniqlashtiriladi. Opa/singil ham shunday: 'sister'.

exercises.explanationUz:
ERKAK ↔ AYOL qarindoshlik juftliklari.

Har bir erkak qarindoshning ayol jufti bor:
  husband     ↔ wife         (er ↔ xotin)
  son         ↔ daughter     (o'g'il ↔ qiz)
  uncle       ↔ aunt         (amaki/tog'a ↔ amma/xola)
  nephew      ↔ niece        (jiyan o'g'il ↔ jiyan qiz)
  brother     ↔ sister       (aka/uka ↔ opa/singil)
  grandfather ↔ grandmother  (bobo ↔ buvi)
  father      ↔ mother
  grandson    ↔ granddaughter

O'ZBEK TILI BILAN FARQ:
O'zbekchada amaki (otaning akasi) va tog'a (onaning akasi)
farqlanadi. Inglizchada IKKALASI ham 'uncle'.
Shunday: amma va xola — ikkalasi 'aunt'.

TALAFFUZ QIYIN so'zlar:
  niece  /niːs/    — 'niis' (nayes EMAS)
  nephew /ˈnefjuː/ — 'NEF-yu'
  aunt   /ɑːnt/    — 'aant' (Britaniyada)

exercises.instructionEn: Which adjectives describe appearance? Which describe character?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi sifatlar tashqi ko'rinishni, qaysilari xarakterni tasvirlaydi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH SIFAT:

  APPEARANCE (tashqi ko'rinish) — KO'Z bilan ko'riladi:
    beautiful, gorgeous, good-looking, lovely, pretty

  CHARACTER (xarakter) — odamning TABIATI:
    kind, patient, lazy, rude, clever, bossy

OSON TEKSHIRUV: rasmga qarab bilib bo'ladimi?
  Ha  → appearance
  Yo'q → character (odamni tanish kerak)

DIQQAT — kim uchun qaysi so'z:
  beautiful, pretty, gorgeous, lovely → asosan AYOLLAR uchun
  good-looking, handsome → asosan ERKAKLAR uchun
  Shuning uchun xatda Emili 'beautiful', Mark esa 'good-looking'.

tasks.whyUz: Tabiat. DIQQAT: 'a patient' oti — bemor degani.

exercises.instructionEn: Now talk about your family. 1 What do your father, mother, brother and sister look like? 2 Can you describe their characters?
exercises.instructionUz: Endi o'z oilangiz haqida gapiring. 1) Ota-onangiz, aka-uka va opa-singlingiz qanday ko'rinadi? 2) Ularning xarakterini tasvirlab bera olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SAVOL — IKKI XIL JAVOB:

  'What does he LOOK LIKE?' → TASHQI KO'RINISH
    He is tall with dark hair and brown eyes.

  'What is he LIKE?' yoki 'Describe his character' → XARAKTER
    He is kind and patient.

Bu ikki savolni chalkashtirmang — farqi bitta so'zda ('look').

KERAKLI SIFATLAR:
  KO'RINISH: tall, short, slim, fat, young, old,
             beautiful, pretty, good-looking, handsome, gorgeous, lovely
  XARAKTER:  kind, patient, clever, funny, friendly, polite,
             lazy, rude, bossy, shy, quiet

SALBIY sifatni 'a bit' bilan yumshating:
  He's a bit lazy. — U biroz dangasa. (muloyimroq)

tasks.whyUz: Bitta o'g'il (birlik) → 's. 'sons' — apostrofsiz, u shunchaki ko'plik (o'g'illar).
Ism ham birlik ot — egalik uchun 's shart.
Ikki egasi, BITTA uy → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga qo'shiladi.
Ko'plik va -s bilan tugaydi → faqat apostrof: boys'.

tasks.whyUz: Birlik → 's. Tartib teskari bo'ladi: ega + narsa.

tasks.prompt: the mother of Ann and John →
tasks.whyUz: Ikki egasi, bitta ona → 's oxirgi ismga.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida egalik APOSTROF bilan ko'rsatiladi.
O'zbekchadagi '-ning' qo'shimchasiga o'xshaydi, lekin joyi teskari:

  o'zbekcha: bola-NING to'pi
  inglizcha: the BOY'S ball

DIQQAT — tartib TESKARI:
  the boy's ball = bolaning to'pi
  EGA birinchi, NARSA keyin. O'zbekchada ham shunday, lekin
  'ning' o'rniga apostrof va 's' ishlatiladi.

APOSTROF QAYERGA QO'YILADI — bu butun qoidaning MAG'ZI:
  ot BIRLIK bo'lsa      → 's   (the boy's)
  ot KO'PLIK va -s bilan tugasa → s'   (the girls')

TALAFFUZDA FARQI YO'Q: 'boys' va 'boy's' va 'boys'' —
uchalasi bir xil eshitiladi. Faqat YOZUVDA farqlanadi.

rules.uzRule: Ot BIRLIK bo'lsa — 's qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add 's when a noun is singular to show possession.

rules.uzRule: Ot KO'PLIK va -s bilan tugasa — faqat apostrof (') qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add ' when a noun is plural and ends in -s to show possession.

rules.uzRule: Ikki (yoki undan ko'p) egasi bo'lsa — 's FAQAT OXIRGISIGA qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add 's to the last noun of a phrase to show possession.
examples: This is Ann and John's mother.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — apostrofni unutish yoki noto'g'ri joyga qo'yish:

  ❌ my sons bicycle    ✅ my son's bicycle     (bitta o'g'il)
  ❌ the boys bicycles  ✅ the boys' bicycles   (bir nechta bola)
  ❌ Jenny desk         ✅ Jenny's desk
  ❌ Tony's and Pam's house  ✅ Tony and Pam's house (bitta uy, ikki egasi)

DIQQAT: 'Tony's and Pam's houses' — bu BOSHQA ma'no:
Toninining uyi va Pamning uyi (ikkita alohida uy).
rule.noteUz:
KO'PLIK -s siz bo'lsa, 's qo'shiladi:
  children → the children's room  (bolalar xonasi)
  men      → the men's room
  women    → the women's team
  people   → the people's choice

Chunki bu so'zlar -s bilan tugamaydi.
rule.extraUz:
's QACHON ISHLATILADI:
  ✅ ODAM va hayvon uchun: Tony's book, the dog's tail
  ✅ vaqt uchun: today's newspaper, a week's holiday
  ✅ mamlakat/shahar uchun: Canada's cities

JONSIZ narsalar uchun odatda 'of' ishlatiladi:
  ✅ the door OF the house (uyning eshigi)
  ⚠️ the house's door — grammatik to'g'ri, lekin tabiiy emas

Va yodda tuting: it's ≠ its
  it's = it is (u ...dir)
  its  = uning (egalik, apostrof YO'Q!)

exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va egalik shakllari hamda egalik sifatlarini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
LIZANING OILA DARAXTI (family tree):

              Bill  &  Carol          (bobo va buvi)
                 │        │
        ┌────────┴───┬────┴────────┐
      John + Ann   Helen + Peter
        │             │
      Lisa (7)      Dave (5)

  Bill va Carol — John va Helenning ota-onasi
  John — Lizaning otasi, Ann — onasi
  Helen — Johnning singlisi, Lizaning ammasi
  Peter — Helenning eri, Lizaning pochchasi (uncle)
  Dave — Helen va Peterning o'g'li, Lizaning amakivachchasi

MATNDA IKKI XIL EGALIK BOR — ularni ajratib oling:

  EGALIK SHAKLI ('s bilan yasalgan):
    my father'S sister, Their son'S name, John and Helen'S parents

  EGALIK SIFATLARI (my, your, his, her, its, our, their):
    MY parents, MY father's, MY aunt, HER husband,
    MY uncle, THEIR son's, MY cousin, OUR grandparents

tasks.en: Hi! I'm Lisa and I'm seven.

tasks.note: 'I'm seven' — 'years old' tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin.

tasks.note: EGALIK SIFATI: my. Ko'plik ega → 'are'.

tasks.note: IKKALASI ham bor: MY (egalik sifati) + father'S (egalik shakli).

tasks.en: She is my aunt.
tasks.note: EGALIK SIFATI: my. Otaning singlisi — 'aunt'.

tasks.en: Peter is her husband.
tasks.note: EGALIK SIFATI: her ('uning' — Helenning). 'her' bu yerda obyekt emas!

tasks.en: He's my uncle.
tasks.note: EGALIK SIFATI: my. Ammaning eri ham 'uncle'.

tasks.en: Their son's name is Dave.
tasks.note: IKKALASI: THEIR (egalik sifati) + son'S (egalik shakli). Ikki bosqichli egalik!

tasks.en: He's five years old.
tasks.note: To'liq shakl: 'five years old'.

tasks.en: He's my cousin.
tasks.note: EGALIK SIFATI: my. 'cousin' — amakivachcha, xolavachcha, jiyan — hammasi bitta so'z.

     ↑ egalik shakli              ↑ egalik sifati

Ikkinchi gap birinchisining QISQARTIRILGAN varianti —
ism o'rniga olmosh keladi.

QARINDOSHLIK ESLATMASI:
  nephew — jiyan (o'g'il)     niece  — jiyan (qiz)
  cousin — amakivachcha       aunt   — amma, xola

  husband — er

tasks.whyUz: Liza — Deyvning amakivachchasi (Deyv Helen va Piterning o'g'li).
Liza — Helen va Piterning jiyani (qiz), chunki Helen Lizaning otasining singlisi.
Matnda: 'Peter is her husband' — demak Helen Piterning xotini.
Ann — Jonning xotini, Jon esa Helenning akasi. Demak Ann Deyvning ammasi.
Oila daraxtining tepasida: Bill & Carol — er-xotin.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida bitta shaxs uchun UCH XIL shakl bor.
Har biri gapda boshqa vazifani bajaradi.

  EGA        OBYEKT     EGALIK SIFATI
  (fe'ldan   (fe'ldan   (otdan
   oldin)     keyin)     oldin)
  ─────────────────────────────────
  I          me         my
  you        you        your
  he         him        his
  she        her        her
  it         it         its
  we         us         our
  you        you        your
  they       them       their

MISOLLAR — bitta shaxs, uch shakl:
  SHE is my aunt.        (ega)
  Look at HER.           (obyekt)
  HER husband is Peter.  (egalik sifati)

O'ZBEKCHA BILAN SOLISHTIRISH:
  u        → he/she
  uni/unga → him/her
  uning    → his/her
rule.warningUz:
ENG CHALKASH JUFTLIKLAR:

  HER ikki vazifada ishlatiladi:
    Look at HER.       — obyekt (unga)
    HER husband        — egalik sifati (uning eri)

  HIS ham ikki vazifada:
    HIS car            — egalik sifati (uning mashinasi)
    The car is HIS.    — egalik olmoshi (uniki)

  ITS va IT'S — MUTLAQO boshqa:
    ITS name is Rex.   — uning ismi (egalik, apostrof YO'Q)
    IT'S a dog.        — u it (it is ning qisqasi)

  THEIR / THERE / THEY'RE — bir xil eshitiladi, boshqa ma'no:
    THEIR son  — ularning o'g'li (egalik)
    THERE is   — bor (Unit 3)
    THEY'RE    — ular ...dir (they are)
rule.noteUz:
EGALIK SIFATIDAN KEYIN ARTIKL QO'YILMAYDI:
  ✅ my book        ❌ my the book
  ✅ their parents  ❌ the their parents

Va egalik sifati OT bilan birga keladi — yolg'iz turmaydi:
  ✅ This is my book.
  ❌ This is my.   (to'g'risi: This is mine.)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in who's, whose, him, them, her or me.
exercises.instructionUz: who's, whose, him, them, her yoki me — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH SO'Z:

  SAVOL so'zlari: who's (kim?), whose (kimning?)
  OBYEKT olmoshlari: him, them, her, me

QANDAY TANLASH:
  • gap savol bo'lsa va ODAM so'ralsa → who's
  • gap savol bo'lsa va EGASI so'ralsa (keyin ot kelsa) → whose
  • fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin bo'lsa → obyekt olmoshi

Javobga ham qarang — u ko'p narsani aytadi.

tasks.whyUz: Javob 'She's ...' — odamning kimligi aytilyapti. Who is Lisa?
Keyin ot ('niece') keladi va javob egalik — Whose.
Javob ISM ('John') — odam so'ralgan. Who is Sally's brother?
'Help' fe'lidan keyin obyekt olmoshi. Gapiruvchi o'ziga yordam so'rayapti → me.
Keyingi gapda 'HE can help you' — demak erkak → him.
Keyingi gapda 'THEY'RE very tall' — ko'plik → them.
'It's HERS' — ayolniki, demak → her. 'to' predlogidan keyin obyekt shakli.
Javob 'He's ...' — odamning kimligi. Who is James?

rule.titleUz: Who's va Whose — bir xil eshitiladi, boshqa ma'no
rule.explanationUz:
Bu ikki so'z BIR XIL o'qiladi: /huːz/.
Lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa.

  WHO'S  = WHO IS  → 'kim?'
           Who's Lisa?  — Liza kim?

  WHOSE  = 'kimning?' → EGASINI so'raydi
           Whose is this ball?  — Bu to'p kimniki?
           Whose dog is it?     — Bu it kimning iti?

QANDAY AJRATISH:
  • 'is' ni qo'yib ko'ring: 'Who is Lisa?' — mantiqli → WHO'S
  • Keyin OT kelsami? → WHOSE (Whose DOG, Whose HOUSE)
  • Javob ODAM bo'lsa → Who's
  • Javob EGALIK ('s bilan) bo'lsa → Whose

rules.uzRule: Who's ...? = Who is ...? — odamning kimligini so'raydi.
rules.enRule: Who's ...? = Who is ...?

rules.uzRule: Whose ...? — narsaning EGASINI so'raydi.
rules.enRule: Whose ...? is used to ask who the possessor is.
examples: Whose house is it? — It's Steven's.

rule.warningUz:
APOSTROF hal qiluvchi:
  WHO'S — apostrof BOR = who is
  WHOSE — apostrof YO'Q = kimning

Bu 'it's / its' juftligiga o'xshaydi:
  it's = it is (apostrof bor)
  its  = uning (apostrof yo'q)

QOIDA: apostrof HAR DOIM tushib qolgan harf o'rnida turadi.
Egalik olmoshlarida (its, whose, hers, ours, theirs) apostrof YO'Q.
rule.noteUz:
JAVOB SHAKLLARI:
  Whose dog is it? — Lyn's.        (qisqa: faqat ism + 's)
                   — It's Lyn's dog. (to'liq)

  Whose house is it? — It's Steven's.

Qisqa javobda ot takrorlanmaydi — faqat ega qoladi.

Berilganlari: mine, his, theirs.

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda IKKI tanlov bor — ikkalasini ham to'g'ri qiling.

QAROR QOIDASI:
  • Keyin OT kelsami? → egalik SIFATI (my, your, his, her, our, their)
  • Ot YO'QMI?        → egalik OLMOSHI (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
  • Savol odam haqidami? → Who's
  • Savol egasi haqidami (keyin ot kelsa)? → Whose

tasks.whyUz: Keyin OT ('sister') keladi → egalik SIFATI 'my'. 'mine sister' XATO.
Gap oxirida ot YO'Q → egalik OLMOSHI 'yours'.
Keyin OT ('dog') keladi va egasi so'ralyapti → Whose.

tasks.promptUz: U kim? — Tom va Juliyaning otasi
tasks.whyUz: Bitta ota, ikki farzand → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga. Ikkalasiga qo'ysangiz, ikkita alohida ota degani bo'ladi.

rule.explanationUz:
Bu betda UCHINCHI olmosh turi qo'shiladi — EGALIK OLMOSHI.

  EGALIK SIFATI    EGALIK OLMOSHI
  (ot BILAN)       (ot SIZ, yolg'iz)
  ─────────────────────────────────
  my               mine
  your             yours
  his              his
  her              hers
  its              — (ishlatilmaydi)
  our              ours
  your             yours
  their            theirs

MISOL:
  This is MY house.  →  It's MINE.
  This is HER house. →  It's HERS.

Ya'ni: otni takrorlamaslik uchun egalik olmoshi ishlatiladi.
O'zbekchada: 'mening uyim' → 'meniki'.

rules.uzRule: Egalik SIFATI otdan OLDIN keladi.
rules.enRule: Possessive adjectives come before a noun.

rules.uzRule: Egalik OLMOSHIDAN keyin ot QO'YILMAYDI.
rules.enRule: Possessive pronouns don't take a noun after them.

rule.warningUz:
KITOBDAGI OGOHLANTIRISH:
  ✅ It's my dog.   (sifat + ot)
  ✅ It's mine.     (olmosh, otsiz)
  ❌ It's mine book.  ← BU XATO!

Ikkalasini birga ishlatib bo'lmaydi.

Va APOSTROF hech qachon qo'yilmaydi:
  ✅ yours, hers, ours, theirs, its
  ❌ your's, her's, our's, their's, it's
rule.noteUz:
'HIS' yagona so'z — u ikkala vazifada ham bir xil:
  This is HIS car.  (sifat)
  The car is HIS.   (olmosh)

'ITS' uchun egalik olmoshi YO'Q. Narsa haqida
'It's its' deb aytilmaydi — buning o'rniga boshqa yo'l topiladi.
rule.extraUz:
QAYERDA ISHLATILADI:
  1) Savolga javobda:
     Whose bag is this? — It's mine. / It's hers.
  2) Taqqoslashda:
     My car is red, yours is blue.
  3) 'of' bilan:
     a friend of mine — mening bir do'stim

rule.titleUz: Present Simple — shakli, imlosi va qo'llanishi
rule.explanationUz:
Present Simple — ingliz tilining ENG KO'P ishlatiladigan zamoni.

SHAKLI juda sodda: fe'l o'zgarmaydi, FAQAT he/she/it bilan -s oladi.

  TASDIQ            INKOR
  I live            I don't live
  you live          you don't live
  he/she/it liveS   he/she/it DOESN'T live
  we live           we don't live
  you live          you don't live
  they live         they don't live

DIQQAT — INKORDA -s TUSHADI:
  ✅ He doesn't live.
  ❌ He doesn't lives.
'-s' allaqachon 'doesn't' ichida bor (does + not).

keyRules.enRule: Most verbs take -s in the affirmative third person singular.

keyRules.uzRule: 3-shaxs birlik INKORDA doesn't + fe'lning asos shakli.
keyRules.enRule: We use doesn't + the base form of the verb to form the negative third person singular.
In all other persons we use don't.

rule.warningUz:
IMLO QOIDALARI (kitobdagi Spelling):

  1) -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugagan fe'llar → -ES
     I finish → he finishES
     I wash   → he washES
     I go     → he goES
     I watch  → he watchES
     I fix    → he fixES

  2) UNDOSH + y bilan tugasa → -y tushadi, -IES qo'shiladi
     I study → he studIES
     I fly   → he flIES
     I try   → he trIES

  3) LEKIN unli + y bo'lsa → oddiy -s
     I play  → he playS
     I enjoy → he enjoyS
     I buy   → he buyS

  Farqni ko'ring: studY (d + y = undosh+y) → studies
                  plaY  (a + y = unli+y)   → plays
rule.noteUz:
QO'LLANISHI (kitobdagi Use):

Present Simple UCH holatda ishlatiladi:

  1) DOIMIY holat (permanent state):
     He lives in Madrid.  — U Madridda yashaydi.
     She is a teacher.    — U o'qituvchi.

  2) TAKRORLANUVCHI harakat (repeated action):
     She goes to the cinema on Saturdays.

  3) KUNDALIK tartib (daily routine):
     I get up at seven o'clock.

HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ISHLATILMAYDI —
uning uchun boshqa zamon bor (Present Continuous).
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ — -s uchta xil o'qiladi (Unit 3 ko'plik qoidasi bilan bir xil):
  /s/  — jarangsizdan keyin: works, likes, sits
  /z/  — jaranglidan keyin:  lives, goes, plays
  /ɪz/ — s, sh, ch, ge dan keyin: washes, finishes, watches

sections.titleUz: Present Simple — savol va qisqa javob

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table. How do we form questions and short answers?
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing. Savol va qisqa javob qanday yasaladi?
exercises.explanationUz: Jadvalni to'liq yozib chiqing — shakl shu bilan mahkamlanadi.

tasks.prompt: I / you — qisqa javob (ha va yo'q)
tasks.answer: Yes, I/you do. No, I/you don't.

tasks.prompt: he / she / it — qisqa javob (ha va yo'q)
tasks.answer: Yes, he/she/it does. No, he/she/it doesn't.

tasks.prompt: we / you / they — qisqa javob (ha va yo'q)
tasks.answer: Yes, we/you/they do. No, we/you/they don't.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in do, does, don't or doesn't.
exercises.instructionUz: do, does, don't yoki doesn't — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir bandda IKKI bo'shliq: savol va javob.

QADAMLAR:
  1) Ega kim? he/she/it bo'lsa → does/doesn't
                qolganlari      → do/don't
  2) Javob 'Yes' bilanmi yoki 'No' bilanmi?
     Yes → do / does
     No  → don't / doesn't

DIQQAT: savoldagi ega va javobdagi ega BOSHQA bo'lishi mumkin:
  A: Do YOU get up late? → B: Yes, WE do.
  (savol 'sizlar'ga, javob 'biz' nomidan)

tasks.whyUz: Tim = he → DOES. Fe'l 'like' asos shaklida.

tasks.prompt: 3  A: ____ they live in a flat?
4  A: ____ Mary work in a hospital?
6  A: ____ they go fishing on Sundays?
7  A: ____ he work in a school?
8  A: ____ you get up late on Sundays?
10  A: ____ she like listening to jazz music?

rule.explanationUz:
Present Simple da savol YORDAMCHI fe'l bilan yasaladi.

  I / you / we / they  →  DO
  he / she / it        →  DOES

TUZILISHI:
  DO/DOES + ega + fe'l (ASOS shakli) + ... ?

  Do you live in Madrid?
  Does he live in Madrid?

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — savolda -s TUSHADI:
  ✅ Does he LIVE?
  ❌ Does he lives?
'-s' allaqachon 'does' ichida bor.

QISQA JAVOB — fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI, faqat do/does qoladi:
  Do you live in Madrid?  — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
  Does he live in Madrid? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
rule.warningUz:
UCHTA ENG KO'P XATO:

  1) Savolda fe'lga -s qo'shish:
     ❌ Does he lives in Madrid?
     ✅ Does he live in Madrid?

  2) Qisqa javobda fe'lni takrorlash:
     ❌ Yes, he lives.
     ✅ Yes, he does.

  3) do/does ni umuman unutish:
     ❌ You live in Madrid?   (og'zaki nutqda bo'ladi, lekin yozuvda xato)
     ✅ Do you live in Madrid?
rule.noteUz:
SO'ROQ SO'ZLI SAVOLLAR ham shu qolipda:
  WHERE do you live?
  WHAT does she like?
  WHY does Helen hate Mondays?

So'roq so'zi ENG OLDINDA turadi, keyin do/does keladi.

Javobda 'because' (chunki) ishlatiladi:
  Why does she hate Mondays?
  — Because she gets up very early.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct pronoun.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri olmoshni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir bandda ikki savol bering:
  1) Bu kim/nima — erkak, ayol, narsa, ko'pmi?
  2) U fe'ldan OLDINmi (ega) yoki KEYINmi (obyekt)?

tasks.whyUz: Uy hayvoni va jinsi ma'lum → he.

rule.explanationUz:
EGA OLMOSHLARI (Subject Personal pronouns):
  Birlik: I, you, he, she, it
  Ko'plik: we, you, they

OBYEKT OLMOSHLARI (Object Personal pronouns):
  Birlik: me, you, him, her, it
  Ko'plik: us, you, them

QAYSI BIRI QACHON:
  EGA olmoshi   — fe'ldan OLDIN
  OBYEKT olmoshi — fe'l yoki PREDLOGDAN keyin

  THEY are doctors.   (ega, fe'ldan oldin)
  Look at ME.         (obyekt, predlogdan keyin)

rules.uzRule: Ega olmoshi FE'LDAN OLDIN, odam yoki ot nomi o'rniga ishlatiladi.
rules.enRule: We use subject personal pronouns before a verb instead of the name of a person or a noun.

rules.uzRule: 'I' HAR DOIM katta harf bilan yoziladi.
rules.enRule: We always write I with a capital letter.

rules.uzRule: 'he' — erkak yoki o'g'il bola uchun.
rules.enRule: We use he for a man or boy.

rules.uzRule: 'she' — ayol yoki qiz uchun.
rules.enRule: We use she for a woman or girl.

rules.uzRule: 'it' — narsa uchun. Jinsi noma'lum hayvon uchun ham 'it'.
rules.enRule: We use it for a thing. We also use it for an animal whose sex we do not know.

rules.uzRule: Hayvon uy hayvonimiz bo'lsa yoki jinsini bilsak — he yoki she.
rules.enRule: If the animal is our pet or we know its sex we can use he or she.
examples: This is my dog Rex. He's one year old.

rules.uzRule: 'they' — ko'plikda odam, hayvon va narsalar uchun.
rules.enRule: We use they in the plural for people, animals or things.

rules.uzRule: Obyekt olmoshi FE'L yoki PREDLOGDAN keyin, to'ldiruvchi sifatida.
rules.enRule: We use object personal pronouns after a verb or a preposition as objects.

rule.warningUz:
'I' KATTA HARF QOIDASI — o'zbek tilida yo'q, shuning uchun
eng ko'p unutiladigan qoida:
  ✅ He's Jack and I'm Steve.
  ❌ He's Jack and i'm Steve.

'I' gap o'rtasida bo'lsa ham katta harf bilan yoziladi.
Boshqa hech qanday olmosh bunday emas: he, she, it, we, they —
hammasi kichik harf bilan.
rule.noteUz:
HAYVONLAR HAQIDA — kitobning nozik qoidasi:

  a tiger → IT      (yovvoyi hayvon, jinsi noma'lum)
  my dog Rex → HE   (uy hayvoni, jinsi ma'lum)

Bu farq muhim: 'it' hayvonni NARSA darajasiga tushiradi.
Uy hayvonini 'it' desangiz, egasi xafa bo'lishi mumkin —
ingliz madaniyatida uy hayvoni oila a'zosi hisoblanadi.
rule.extraUz:
'YOU' — eng qulay olmosh:
  • birlik ham, ko'plik ham (sen / sizlar)
  • ega ham, obyekt ham (sen / senga)
Ya'ni to'rt vazifada bitta so'z. O'zbekchada esa
'sen, siz, sizlar, senga, sizga' — bir necha shakl bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the possessive adjective or the possessive pronoun.
exercises.instructionUz: Egalik sifati yoki egalik olmoshini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OSON QOIDA: keyin OT bormi?
  Bor  → egalik SIFATI (my, your, his, her, its, our, their)
  Yo'q → egalik OLMOSHI (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)

tasks.whyUz: 'brother' oti bor → egalik sifati. Bu yerda munosabat bildirilyapti.
Gap oxirida, ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi.
'his' — sifat ham, olmosh ham. Bu yerda ot bilan.
'his' o'zgarmaydi — ikkala vazifada ham bir xil.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the possessives table.
exercises.instructionUz: Egalik jadvalini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz: Butun jadvalni yozib chiqing — ikki ustunni birga yodlash osonroq.

tasks.whyUz: Kitob aytadi: 'it' uchun egalik olmoshi yo'q.

rule.explanationUz:
EGALIK SIFATLARI (Possessive adjectives):
  Birlik: my, your, his, her, its
  Ko'plik: our, your, their

EGALIK OLMOSHLARI (Possessive pronouns):
  Birlik: mine, yours, his, hers, — (yo'q)
  Ko'plik: ours, yours, theirs

FARQI BITTA:
  EGALIK SIFATI  → keyin OT keladi
  EGALIK OLMOSHI → keyin ot KELMAYDI

  This is MY car.  →  It's MINE.
         ↑ + ot            ↑ otsiz

rules.uzRule: Egalik sifatlari ikki narsani ko'rsatadi: a) narsa kimga tegishli, b) odamlar orasidagi munosabat. OTDAN OLDIN turadi.
rules.enRule: Possessive adjectives show a) that something belongs to someone and b) the relationship between two or more people. We put them before nouns.
examples: This is my house. (narsa kimga tegishli)

rules.uzRule: Egalik olmoshlari narsa kimga tegishli ekanini ko'rsatadi. Ulardan keyin OT QO'YILMAYDI.
rules.enRule: Possessive pronouns show that something belongs to someone. They do not take a noun after them.
examples: This is my car. It's mine.

rules.uzRule: 'it' uchun egalik olmoshi YO'Q.
rules.enRule: Note that there is no possessive pronoun for it.

rule.warningUz:
IKKITA XATO:

  1) Egalik olmoshidan keyin ot qo'yish:
     ❌ It's mine car.   ✅ It's my car. / It's mine.

  2) Apostrof qo'yish:
     ❌ your's, her's, our's, their's, it's (egalik ma'nosida)
     ✅ yours, hers, ours, theirs, its

EGALIK olmoshlarida apostrof HECH QACHON bo'lmaydi.
rule.noteUz:
IKKI VAZIFA — kitob aytgan muhim nuqta:

  a) NARSA kimga tegishli:
     This is MY house.  — Bu mening uyim.

  b) ODAMLAR orasidagi MUNOSABAT:
     He is MY brother.  — U mening akam.

Ikkinchisida 'egalik' emas, QARINDOSHLIK bildiriladi.
Lekin grammatik shakli bir xil.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the possessive form and say it in three ways.
exercises.instructionUz: Egalik shaklini yozing va uni uch xil aytib ko'ring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi uch xil aytish usuli:
  1) ot + 's (egalik shakli)
  2) egalik sifati
  3) belong to + obyekt olmoshi

tasks.prompt: the hat of the woman → (egalik shakli)
the room of the boys → (egalik shakli)
tasks.whyUz: Ko'plik va -s bilan tugaydi → faqat apostrof.

tasks.prompt: the car of Tony and Mary → (egalik shakli)
Tony and Mary's car → (egalik sifati bilan)
tasks.speak: Tony and Mary's car → (egalik sifati bilan)

tasks.prompt: Tony and Mary's car → (belong to bilan)
tasks.speak: Tony and Mary's car → (belong to bilan)

rule.explanationUz:
Otga qo'shiladigan apostrof egalikni bildiradi.
Apostrof QAYERGA qo'yilishi otning shakliga bog'liq.

  BIRLIK ot            → 's
  KO'PLIK ot (-s bilan) → '
  Ikki egasi            → 's faqat OXIRGISIGA

rules.uzRule: Ot BIRLIK bo'lsa — 's qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add 's when a noun is singular to show possession.
examples: It's her hat. The hat belongs to her.

rules.uzRule: Ot KO'PLIK va -s bilan tugasa — faqat apostrof (') qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add ' when a noun is plural and ends in -s to show possession.
examples: It's their room. The room belongs to them.

rules.uzRule: Bir necha egasi bo'lsa — 's faqat OXIRGI otga qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add 's to the last noun of a phrase to show possession.
examples: This is Tony and Mary's car.
It's their car. The car belongs to them.

rule.warningUz:
Kitob har bir qoidani UCH XIL aytish bilan tushuntiradi:

  It's the WOMAN'S hat.       (egalik shakli)
  It's HER hat.               (egalik sifati)
  The hat BELONGS TO her.     (belong to fe'li)

Uchalasi bir xil ma'no. Bu — foydali tekshiruv usuli:
agar 'belongs to' bilan aytib bo'lsa, egalik to'g'ri qo'yilgan.
rule.noteUz:
'BELONG TO' fe'li:
  The hat belongs TO her.  — Shlyapa unga tegishli.
  'to' predlogi SHART va undan keyin OBYEKT olmoshi keladi:
  belongs to me / him / her / us / them
  ('belongs to she' XATO)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in Who's or Whose.
exercises.instructionUz: Who's yoki Whose — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz: Javobga qarang: odammi yoki egalikmi?

tasks.whyUz: Javob 'He's my brother' — odamning kimligi → Who is.
Keyin 'car' oti keladi va javob egalik → Whose.

tasks.prompt: "____ bag is on the table?" "It's Sheila's."

rule.explanationUz:
Ikkalasi ham so'roq so'zi, lekin BOSHQA narsani so'raydi.

  WHO   — ODAM haqida so'raydi (kim?)
  WHOSE — EGALIK haqida so'raydi (kimning? kimniki?)

Talaffuzi bir xil: /huː/ va /huːz/.
'Who's' (= who is) va 'whose' esa TO'LIQ bir xil: /huːz/.

rules.uzRule: 'Who' — so'roq so'zi. Odam haqida so'rash uchun.
rules.enRule: Who is a question word. We use it to ask about people.

rules.uzRule: 'Whose' — so'roq so'zi. Egalik haqida so'rash uchun.
rules.enRule: Whose is a question word. We use it to ask about possession.

rule.warningUz:
AJRATISH USULI:
  • Javob ODAM (He's my brother) → WHO
  • Javob EGALIK ('s bilan: It's Sheila's) → WHOSE

YOZUVDA:
  Who's = Who is  (apostrof BOR)
  Whose = kimning (apostrof YO'Q)
rule.noteUz:
'Whose' ikki xil ishlatiladi:
  Whose IS this house?   — otsiz (Whose = kimniki)
  Whose HOUSE is this?   — ot bilan (Whose = kimning)

Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri va bir xil ma'no beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the imperative form.
exercises.instructionUz: Buyruq shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq — fe'lning asos shakli. Inkor — don't + asos shakl.

tasks.prompt: to open the door → (tasdiq buyruq, muloyim)
tasks.speak: to open the door → (tasdiq buyruq, muloyim)

rule.explanationUz:
Buyruq mayli — eng sodda gap turi.
EGA YO'Q, zamon yo'q, faqat FE'L.

  TASDIQ: fe'lning ASOS shakli
    Come here.  — Bu yerga kel.

  INKOR: don't + fe'lning ASOS shakli
    Don't look at it.  — Unga qarama.

rules.uzRule: TASDIQ buyruq — fe'lning asos shakli bilan yasaladi.
rules.enRule: We form affirmative orders or instructions with the base form of the verb.

rules.uzRule: INKOR buyruq — don't + fe'lning asos shakli.
rules.enRule: We form negative orders or instructions with don't + base form of the verb.

rules.uzRule: Buyruq mayli BUYRUQ berish yoki KO'RSATMA berish uchun ishlatiladi.
rules.enRule: We use the imperative to give orders or instructions.
examples: First add the milk then add the sugar. (instruction — ko'rsatma)

rule.warningUz:
BUYRUQDA EGA QO'YILMAYDI:
  ✅ Come here.        ❌ You come here.
  ✅ Don't look at it. ❌ You don't look at it.

Va fe'l HECH QANDAY qo'shimcha olmaydi:
  ✅ Come    ❌ Comes  ❌ Coming  ❌ To come

'to be' fe'li buyruqda 'BE' shaklida:
  ✅ Be careful!   ❌ Are careful!
rule.noteUz:
BUYRUQ ↔ KO'RSATMA — farqi ohangda va vaziyatda:

  ORDER (buyruq)      — kimgadir nima qilishni AYTASIZ
    Stand up!  Sit down!  Come here!
    Ko'pincha undov belgisi bilan.

  INSTRUCTION (ko'rsatma) — qanday qilishni TUSHUNTIRASIZ
    First add the milk, then add the sugar.
    Retsept, qo'llanma, yo'l ko'rsatishda.
    Ko'pincha 'first, then, next, finally' bilan.

Grammatik shakli BIR XIL — faqat maqsad boshqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the Present Simple table for the verb 'work'.
exercises.instructionUz: 'work' fe'li uchun Present Simple jadvalini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvalning uchala ustunini ham yozib chiqing.
Har bir shaxs uchun: tasdiq, savol, inkor.

tasks.answer: I work / Do I work? / I don't work
you work / Do you work? / you don't work
he works / Does he work? / he doesn't work
tasks.whyUz: 3-shaxs birlik: tasdiqda -s, savol va inkorda DOES.

tasks.answer: she works / Does she work? / she doesn't work
it works / Does it work? / it doesn't work
we work / Do we work? / we don't work
they work / Do they work? / they don't work

exercises.instructionEn: Write the long and short negative forms.
exercises.instructionUz: Inkorning to'liq va qisqa shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi jadvalda inkorning IKKI ustuni bor:
  Long form  — do not / does not
  Short form — don't / doesn't

Og'zaki nutqda qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling: write the third person singular form.
exercises.instructionUz: Imlo: 3-shaxs birlik shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'p fe'llar oddiy -s oladi:
     I work → he works

  2) -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa → -es:
     I finish → he finishes,  I go → he goes

  3) UNDOSH + y bilan tugasa → y tushadi, -ies:
     I fly → he flies

  4) UNLI + y bilan tugasa → oddiy -s:
     I play → he plays

3 va 4-qoidani ajratish uchun 'y' dan OLDINGI harfga qarang.

exercises.instructionEn: How is the third person -s/-es pronounced?
exercises.instructionUz: 3-shaxs -s/-es qanday o'qiladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH GURUH (kitobdagi Pronunciation):

  /s/  — /f/, /k/, /p/, /t/ dan keyin      → he sits
  /ɪz/ — /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/, /z/ dan keyin → he watches
  /z/  — QOLGAN BARCHA tovushlardan keyin  → he runs

OSON YO'L: so'zni ayting va oxirgi tovushni eshiting.

tasks.whyUz: 'run' /n/ bilan tugaydi — boshqa tovush → /z/. Kitobdagi namuna.

exercises.instructionEn: Time Expressions we use with the present simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Simple bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt iboralari.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu iboralar gapda Present Simple ekanini KO'RSATADI.

rule.explanationUz:
Present Simple ning UCHALA shakli bitta jadvalda.
'work' fe'li misolida:

  TASDIQ          SAVOL              INKOR (qisqa)
  I work          Do I work?         I don't work
  you work        Do you work?       you don't work
  he workS        DoeS he work?      he doeSn't work
  she workS       DoeS she work?     she doeSn't work
  it workS        DoeS it work?      it doeSn't work
  we work         Do we work?        we don't work
  you work        Do you work?       you don't work
  they work       Do they work?      they don't work

DIQQAT — 'S' HARFI FAQAT BITTA JOYDA:
  tasdiqda  → fe'lda (he workS)
  savolda   → 'does' da (DoeS he work?)
  inkorda   → 'doesn't' da (he doeSn't work)

Ya'ni 's' bir gapda IKKI MARTA kelmaydi:
  ❌ Does he works?      ❌ He doesn't works.
  ✅ Does he work?       ✅ He doesn't work.

keyRules.uzRule: Present Simple EGA (ot yoki shaxs olmoshi) va FE'L dan tuziladi.
keyRules.enRule: We form the present simple with the subject (noun or personal pronoun) and the verb.
The third person singular takes -s or -es in the affirmative.

keyRules.uzRule: SAVOL: do + ega + fe'lning asos shakli (3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari). 3-shaxs birlikda: does + ega + asos shakl.
keyRules.enRule: We use do + subject + base form of the verb in all persons except for the third person singular. We use does + subject + base form of the verb in this person.

keyRules.uzRule: INKOR: ega + don't + asos shakl (3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari). 3-shaxs birlikda: ega + doesn't + asos shakl.
keyRules.enRule: We use subject + don't + base form of the verb in all persons in the negative except for the third person singular. We use subject + doesn't + base form of the verb in this person.

rule.warningUz:
TO'LIQ VA QISQA SHAKL:

  LONG FORM        SHORT FORM
  I do not work    I don't work
  he does not work he doesn't work

Og'zaki nutqda DOIM qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.
To'liq shakl rasmiy yozuvda yoki ta'kidlash uchun:
  'I do NOT want to go!' — qat'iy rad etish.
rule.noteUz:
QO'LLANISHI (Use):

Present Simple ikki holatda ishlatiladi:

  1) KUNDALIK TARTIB yoki ODAT:
     I get up at seven every day.  (kundalik tartib)
     I often watch TV in the evenings.  (odat)

  2) DOIMIY HOLAT:
     I live in a big house.

HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ISHLATILMAYDI.
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ — 3-shaxs -s/-es uch xil o'qiladi:

  /s/  — /f/, /k/, /p/, /t/ tovushlaridan keyin
         he sits, he works, he stops, he laughs

  /ɪz/ — /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/, /z/ tovushlaridan keyin
         he watches, he washes, he uses
         (yangi bo'g'in qo'shiladi)

  /z/  — boshqa BARCHA tovushlardan keyin
         he runs, he lives, he goes, he plays

O'YIN QOIDASI:

  ✅ Yes, he is.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkala maqol ham BITTA fikrni aytadi:
bola ota-onasiga o'xshaydi.

Birinchisi — Unit 4 ning SARLAVHASI.
Shuning uchun butun unit oila haqida.

tasks.en: Like father, like son. / Like mother, like daughter.
tasks.uz: Ota qanday bo'lsa, o'g'il ham shunday. / Ona qanday bo'lsa, qiz ham shunday.
tasks.note:
MA'NOSI: bola ota-onasining xulqi va odatlarini takrorlaydi.

TUZILISHI juda qisqa — fe'l YO'Q:
  To'liq shakli: 'As the father is, so is the son.'
  Maqolda esa faqat 'Like ... , like ...' qoldirilgan.

'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS — 'kabi, o'xshash' degani.

Bu maqol ham ijobiy, ham salbiy ma'noda ishlatiladi:
  otasi ham shifokor, o'g'li ham → maqtov
  otasi ham kech qoladi, o'g'li ham → tanbeh

tasks.en: The apple never falls far from the tree.
tasks.note:
MA'NOSI: bola oilasiga o'xshaydi — undan uzoqlashmaydi.

Bu maqol O'ZBEKCHADA HAM AYNAN BOR:
  'Olma daraxtidan uzoqqa tushmaydi.'
So'zma-so'z bir xil — chunki tabiat kuzatuvi hamma xalqda bir xil.

GRAMMATIKA: 'never' — inkor so'zi. U bilan ikkinchi inkor
qo'shilmaydi:
  ✅ The apple NEVER falls.
  ❌ The apple never doesn't fall.

Va 'falls' — 3-shaxs birlik -s (Unit 4 grammatikasi).

wordFormation.ruleUz: grand- oldi qo'shimchasi — bir avlod uzoq
wordFormation.explanationUz: 'grand-' qo'shilsa, qarindoshlik bir avlod uzoqlashadi. 'great-' qo'shilsa — yana bir avlod.
Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING qo'shimchasini oladi. Bu Unit 4 ning asosiy grammatikasi.
'O'zim, o'zing, o'zi' ma'nosini beradi. Ega bilan to'ldiruvchi bir xil odam bo'lganda ishlatiladi.
Bu betdagi kasblar. Kasb oldida DOIM a/an turadi.
Fe'lga 'back' qo'shilsa, 'javob sifatida' ma'nosi paydo bo'ladi.
Ingliz tilida ko'p qarindoshlik so'zlari juft bo'lib keladi. Juftlik bilan yodlash osonroq.
Kun nomlari qadimgi xudolar va sayyoralar nomidan kelib chiqqan. Hammasi KATTA HARF bilan yoziladi.
Fe'lga -ing qo'shilsa, u 'shu ishni qilish' ma'nosini beradi va otdek ishlatiladi.
Apostrof joyi ot birlikmi-ko'plikmi ekaniga bog'liq.
Eng kuchlidan eng kuchsizgacha to'rt daraja.
Har bir shaxs uchun ega, obyekt va egalik shakllari bor. Uchalasini birga yodlang.
Bu juftliklar talaffuzda farq qilmaydi — faqat yozuvda. Ma'nolari esa butunlay boshqa.
Egalik sifati OT bilan keladi, egalik olmoshi YOLG'IZ turadi.
Bitta inglizcha so'z bir necha o'zbekcha so'zni qoplaydi.
Ko'pchiligiga -s qo'shiladi, lekin apostrof HECH QACHON qo'yilmaydi.
Ko'pchilik fe'llar shunchaki -s oladi.
Bu tovushlardan keyin -s eshitilmaydi, shuning uchun -es qo'shiladi va yangi bo'g'in paydo bo'ladi.
'y' dan OLDIN undosh bo'lsa, 'y' tushadi va -ies qo'shiladi. Unli bo'lsa — 'y' qoladi.
do/does + not qisqaradi. Inkorda fe'l ASOS shaklida qoladi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: do / does — savol va inkor yordamchisi
wordFormation.explanationUz: Present Simple da savol va inkor UCHUN yordamchi fe'l kerak. Asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.
Har bir ijobiy sifatning salbiy jufti bor — juftlik bilan yodlash osonroq.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Ko'rinish sifatlari — kim uchun qaysi so'z
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida chiroylilik sifatlari erkak va ayol uchun boshqa-boshqa.
Otga -y qo'shilsa, 'shu xususiyatli' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi.
Ba'zi kasblarda ayol shakli -ess qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi. Hozirgi ingliz tilida ko'pchilik bu farqni ishlatmaydi.

items.note: erkak va ayol uchun bir xil

wordFormation.explanationUz: Bir xil otni takrorlamaslik uchun 'the one' (birlik) yoki 'the ones' (ko'plik) ishlatiladi.
Kuchsizdan kuchligacha tartib. Kuchli sifatlar oldiga 'very' qo'yilmaydi.
Har qanday xat va inshoda shu uchta qism bo'ladi.
Rus/o'zbek tilidagi o'xshash so'zga tayanib xato qilinadigan so'zlar.
Har bir shaxs uchun to'rt shakl bor. Ularni QATOR bo'yicha yodlang — birini bilsangiz, qolganini eslaysiz.
Bitta fikrni uch xil ifodalash mumkin — bu til boyligini oshiradi.

items.note: uchinchisi: The hat belongs to her.

wordFormation.explanationUz: 'to' tushadi, hech qanday qo'shimcha qo'shilmaydi.
Retsept va qo'llanmalarda qadamlarni tartiblash uchun.
Savol va inkorda yordamchi fe'l egaga qarab tanlanadi.

items.derivedUz: Do you work? / I don't work
Does he work? / He doesn't work

wordFormation.explanationUz: Apostrof 'o' harfi o'rnida turadi.
Fe'lning OXIRGI HARFIGA qarab tanlanadi.
Har bir vaqt so'zi o'z predlogiga ega. 'at night' — asosiy istisno.
Bu so'zlar fe'ldan OLDIN turadi ('to be' fe'lidan esa KEYIN).

items.derived: I usually get up at seven.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ba'zi olmoshlar ikki vazifada bir xil ko'rinadi — chalkashmaslik uchun GAP TUZILISHIGA qarang.
Bu juftliklarda sifat va olmosh SHAKLI boshqa — eng ko'p xato shu yerda.
Dialogda deyarli har doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.
Takrorlanadigan otni almashtirish uchun 'one' ishlatiladi.
Ingliz tilida kasb nomlari bir necha xil yasaladi. Ba'zilari boshqa tildan olingan.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Kasb haqida savol — birlik va ko'plik
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ko'plikda uchta narsa birga o'zgaradi: olmosh, fe'l va 'job' so'zi.

items.derived: What's his job? — He's a chef.
What's her job? — She's a ballerina.
What are their jobs? — They're firefighters.

wordFormation.ruleUz: its ↔ it's — eng ko'p chalkashadigan juftlik
wordFormation.explanationUz: Talaffuzi bir xil, ma'nosi butunlay boshqa. Apostrof hal qiluvchi.
Apostrof + s ikki xil bo'lishi mumkin — kontekstdan farqlanadi.
Bu ikkita fe'l qoidaga bo'ysunmaydi. Ular eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llar, shuning uchun alohida yodlanadi.
Ko'p uy ishlari 'do the ...' shaklida aytiladi. Bu turg'un birikmalar.
Ko'p mashg'ulotlar 'go + -ing' shaklida aytiladi.
Ba'zi fe'llar predlog talab qiladi, ba'zilari yo'q. Buni yodlab olish kerak.
Faqat 'not like' uchun don't/doesn't kerak. Qolganlari to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatiladi.

items.derived: he doesn't like / they don't like

wordFormation.ruleUz: Inkor va savol — do/does bilan yoki 'to be' bilan
wordFormation.explanationUz: Eng muhim farq: 'to be' fe'li bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI.

items.derived: He doesn't work. / Does he work?
He isn't a teacher. / Is he a teacher?
He hasn't got a car. / Has he got a car?
He can't swim. / Can he swim?

wordFormation.explanationUz: Bu birikmalarda predlog o'zgarmaydi — butun holda yodlanadi.
Matnda uchraydigan kasblar.
Bu otlar birlikda ishlatilmaydi — juft narsalarni bildiradi.
Soat va davomiylik ifodalari.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm + ism and I'm + yosh + years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm Tony Philips and I'm seventeen years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men Toni Filipsman va o'n yetti yoshdaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Yosh 'BE' fe'li bilan aytiladi: I AM 17.
'I have 17 years' — NOTO'G'RI (bu o'zbek/rus tilidan ta'sir).

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm + bo'y/gavda + WITH + soch + and + ko'z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men baland bo'yli va nozikman, sochim kalta va to'q rangli, ko'zlarim jigarrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tartib: bo'y → gavda → WITH → soch → ko'z.
'hair' birlikda, 'eyes' ko'plikda.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are + son + of us in our family.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are seven of us in our family.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oilamizda yetti kishimiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'of us' — 'bizdan'. Oila a'zolari sonini aytishning tabiiy usuli.

sentencePatterns.formula: my sister, ISM, aged SON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: my sister, Liz, aged nine
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: to'qqiz yoshli singlim Liz
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa tanishtirish. Ism ikki vergul orasida, keyin 'aged + son'.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody works AT the + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He works at the local hospital.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mahalliy kasalxonada ishlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Muassasa bilan AT: at the hospital, at the school, at a bank.
Muassasa TURINI aytganda IN: a teacher IN a primary school.

sentencePatterns.formula: In my free time, I love/like + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In my free time, I love playing computer games and listening to rock music.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynashni va musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
like/love/enjoy dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.
  ✅ I like going.   ❌ I like go.   ❌ I like to going.

sentencePatterns.formula: I don't like + fe'l-ING + , though.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't like going to the theatre, though.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Teatrga borishni esa yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'though' gap oxirida — oldingi fikrga qarshi ma'no qo'shadi.
Oldidan vergul qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is the + ot + 'S + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is the boy's ball. This is Jenny's desk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu bolaning to'pi. Bu Jennining stoli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik ot bilan 's. Ega birinchi, narsa keyin.

sentencePatterns.formula: These are the + KO'PLIK-s' + narsalar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: These are the boys' bicycles.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bular bolalarning velosipedlari.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik -s bilan tugasa, faqat apostrof qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ISM and ISM's + narsa (bitta narsa, ikki egasi).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is Ann and John's mother.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu Ann va Jonning onasi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 's faqat OXIRGI ismga. Ikkalasiga qo'ysangiz — ikkita alohida ona degani bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I love / like / don't like / hate + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like fishing and I love reading. I don't like camping though.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Baliq ovlashni yoqtiraman va kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman. Chodirda dam olishni esa yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu to'rt fe'ldan keyin ikkinchi fe'l DOIM -ING oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ... , but I don't like + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like fishing and I love reading, but I don't like camping.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Baliq ovlashni yoqtiraman va kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman, lekin chodirda dam olishni yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' bilan qarama-qarshi fikr. Vergul 'but' dan OLDIN qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ON + hafta kuni.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I go to the cinema on Saturday. / I play football on Mondays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shanba kuni kinoga boraman. / Dushanba kunlari futbol o'ynayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Kun bilan ON. Ko'plikda (on Mondays) — 'har dushanba' degani.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + EGALIK SHAKLI + qarindoshlik. He/She is + EGALIK SIFATI + qarindoshlik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dave is John and Ann's nephew. He is their nephew.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Deyv — Jon va Annning jiyani. U ularning jiyani.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ikkinchi gap birinchisining qisqartirilgani: ism o'rniga olmosh keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Who's + ISM? — He's/She's + EGALIK SHAKLI + qarindoshlik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who's Dave? — He's Lisa's cousin.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Deyv kim? — U Lizaning amakivachchasi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odamning kimligini so'rash. Who's = Who is.

sentencePatterns.formula: Whose + ot + is + ISM? — He's/She's + EGALIK SHAKLI + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whose son is John? — He's Carol and Bill's son.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon kimning o'g'li? — U Kerol va Billning o'g'li.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Egasini so'rash. 'Whose' dan keyin DOIM ot keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Look at + OBYEKT olmoshi. + EGA olmoshi + is/are + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at them. They're desks. Look at her. She's Mary.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularga qara. Ular partalar. Unga qara. U Meri.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi gapda obyekt shakli, ikkinchisida ega shakli.
Bu farqni sezmaslik — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is + ISM/he/she + your + qarindoshlik? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is Tony your father? — No, he isn't. Is he your uncle? — Yes, he is.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni sizning otangizmi? — Yo'q. U sizning amakingizmi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ha/yo'q savoli. Qisqa javobda ot takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Their son's name is + ISM.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Their son's name is Dave.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning o'g'lining ismi Deyv.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
IKKI BOSQICHLI egalik: THEIR (sifat) + son'S (shakl) + name.
O'zbekchada ham shunday: ular-NING o'g'li-NING ismi.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is + EGALIK SIFATI + ot. → It's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is my house. → It's mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mening uyim. → U meniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Otni takrorlamaslik uchun egalik olmoshi ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Whose + ot + is this? — I think it's ISM's. Yes, it's his/hers.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whose bag is this? — I think it's Lyn's. Yes, it's hers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu sumka kimning? — Menimcha, Linniki. Ha, u uniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'I think' — taxminni yumshatadi. Javobda avval ism + 's, keyin olmosh.

sentencePatterns.formula: he/she/it + fe'l + S (tasdiq).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He works at the local hospital. She goes to the cinema on Saturdays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mahalliy kasalxonada ishlaydi. U shanba kunlari kinoga boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Faqat 3-shaxs birlikda -s. Boshqa shaxslarda fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: he/she/it + DOESN'T + fe'l (asos shakli).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He doesn't live in London.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Londonda yashamaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Inkorda -s TUSHADI: doesn't LIVE (doesn't lives EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: I/you/we/they + DON'T + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't like going to the theatre.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Teatrga borishni yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qolgan barcha shaxslarda don't.

sentencePatterns.formula: Present Simple — doimiy holat va takrorlanuvchi harakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He lives in Madrid. She goes to the cinema on Saturdays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Madridda yashaydi. U shanba kunlari kinoga boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ISHLATILMAYDI —
faqat doimiy holat, odat va kundalik tartib uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do/Does + ega + fe'l (asos) + ...? — Yes, ... do/does. / No, ... don't/doesn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Does Tim like watching TV? — Yes, he does.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tim televizor ko'rishni yoqtiradimi? — Ha, yoqtiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolda fe'l -s OLMAYDI. Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Why does + ega + hate/like/love + KUNlar? — ... because + ega + fe'l+S.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why does Helen hate Mondays? — Helen hates Mondays because she gets up very early.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega Helen dushanbani yomon ko'radi? — Chunki u juda erta turadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'because' dan keyin fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi: she getS, she goeS.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody + hates/doesn't like/likes/loves + KUNlar (ko'plikda).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Helen hates Mondays. She loves Sundays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Helen dushanbalarni yomon ko'radi. U yakshanbalarni juda yaxshi ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odat haqida gapirganda kun nomi KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi: Mondays, Sundays.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She is + KO'RINISH sifati + WITH + soch va ko'z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's very beautiful with fair hair and gorgeous green eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U juda go'zal, sochi sariq va ko'zlari maftunkor yashil.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tashqi ko'rinish qolipi. 'with' dan keyin soch va ko'z.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She is + ijobiy sifat + BUT + a bit + salbiy sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is good-looking, but he's a bit lazy and rude.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kelishgan, lekin biroz dangasa va qo'pol.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'a bit' salbiy sifatni yumshatadi — muloyim gapirish usuli.
Avval ijobiy, keyin salbiy — bu ham muloyimlik qoidasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What does + ega + look like? ↔ What is + ega + like?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does your father look like? ↔ What is your father like?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Otangiz qanday ko'rinadi? ↔ Otangiz qanday odam?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'look like' — TASHQI KO'RINISH.
'be like' — XARAKTER.
Farq faqat 'look' so'zida, lekin ma'no butunlay boshqa.

sentencePatterns.formula: What does + ega + look like? — He's/She's + sifat + WITH + soch va ko'z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does Philip look like? — He's good-looking with short fair hair and green eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Filip qanday ko'rinadi? — U kelishgan, sochi kalta va sariq, ko'zlari yashil.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TASHQI KO'RINISH savoli. 'look' so'zi SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: What is + ega + like? — He's/She's + xarakter sifati.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is he like? — He's lazy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday odam? — U dangasa.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: XARAKTER savoli. 'look' YO'Q. 'do/does' ham kerak emas — 'be' fe'li.

sentencePatterns.formula: The one + predlog + joy / with the + soch.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The one over there, with the long fair hair. Not her — the one next to her.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Anavi yerdagisi, uzun sariq sochlisi. U emas — uning yonidagisi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Olomon ichida odamni ko'rsatish. 'the one' otni almashtiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you mean + ot? — No! Not her/him — the one ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you mean the girl in the dark T-shirt? — No! Not her — the one next to her.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qora futbolkadagi qizni aytyapsanmi? — Yo'q! U emas — uning yonidagisi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Aniqlashtirish va tuzatish. 'Not her' — obyekt olmoshi (Unit 4).

sentencePatterns.formula: Isn't she/he + sifat? — Mmm, not bad.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Isn't she beautiful? — Mmm, not bad.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U go'zal emasmi? — Hmm, yomon emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Inkor savol rozilik kutib so'raladi.
'not bad' — kamtarona javob, to'liq rozi bo'lmaslik.

sentencePatterns.formula: Yes, I do actually.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you know her? — Yes, I do actually. She's my sister.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uni tanaysanmi? — Ha, aslida taniyman. U mening singlim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javob (Yes, I do) + 'actually' kutilmagan ma'lumot oldidan.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA olmoshi + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are doctors. He's Jack and I'm Steve.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular shifokor. U Jek, men esa Stivman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ega olmoshi fe'ldan oldin. 'I' doim katta harf bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: fe'l/predlog + OBYEKT olmoshi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at me.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga qara.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'at' predlogidan keyin obyekt shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is + EGALIK SIFATI + ot. → It's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is my car. It's mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mening mashinam. U meniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Sifatdan keyin ot bor, olmoshdan keyin ot yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's the + ot + 'S + narsa. = It's + egalik sifati + narsa. = The narsa belongs to + obyekt olmoshi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's the woman's hat. It's her hat. The hat belongs to her.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu ayolning shlyapasi. Bu uning shlyapasi. Shlyapa unga tegishli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bitta fikrni uch xil aytish. 'belong to' dan keyin obyekt olmoshi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Who's + ISM? — He's/She's + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who's George? — He's my brother.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jorj kim? — U mening akam.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odam haqida savol.

sentencePatterns.formula: Whose is this + ot? — It's + ISM's.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whose is this house? — It's Sheila's.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu uy kimniki? — Sheilaniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Egalik haqida savol. Javobda ot takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Fe'l (asos shakli) + ... — buyruq.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Come here. Stand up! First add the milk then add the sugar.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerga kel. Tur! Avval sut qo'shing, keyin shakar qo'shing.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ega yo'q. Buyruq va ko'rsatma uchun bir xil shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: Don't + fe'l (asos shakli) + ... — inkor buyruq.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't look at it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unga qarama.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Har doim 'don't' — kimga aytilishidan qat'i nazar.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + fe'l (+S agar he/she/it bo'lsa).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I work. He works. They work.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ishlayman. U ishlaydi. Ular ishlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq shakli. -s FAQAT he/she/it bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do/Does + EGA + fe'l (asos shakli) + ... ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you like football? Does he like tennis?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sen futbolni yoqtirasanmi? U tennisni yoqtiradimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolda fe'l -s OLMAYDI — 's' 'does' ichida.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + don't/doesn't + fe'l (asos shakli).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't play. He doesn't play.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men o'ynamayman. U o'ynamaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Inkorda ham fe'l -s olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + fe'l + vaqt iborasi (kundalik tartib).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I get up at seven every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har kuni yettida turaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Vaqt iborasi odatda gap OXIRIDA turadi.
'at seven' — soat, 'every day' — takrorlanish.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + often/usually/always + fe'l (odat).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I often watch TV in the evenings.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechqurunlari tez-tez televizor ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Takrorlanish ravishi fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + fe'l (doimiy holat).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I live in a big house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men katta uyda yashayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Vaqt iborasi kerak emas — holat doimiy.

sentencePatterns.formula: Look at + OBYEKT olmoshi. + EGA olmoshi + is/are + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at it. It is a camel. Look at her. She is a singer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unga qara. U tuya. Unga qara. U qo'shiqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi gapda obyekt shakli (predlogdan keyin),
ikkinchisida ega shakli (fe'ldan oldin).

sentencePatterns.formula: EGALIK SIFATI + name/hair + is + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Her name is Sara. Her hair is long and red.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning ismi Sara. Uning sochi uzun va qizil.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Otdan oldin egalik SIFATI. 'hair' birlikda — 'is'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is that ISM's + ot? — Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + EGALIK SIFATI + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is that Mark's trumpet? — Yes, it's his. It's his trumpet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu Markning karnayimi? — Ha, uniki. Bu uning karnayi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birinchi javob otsiz (olmosh), ikkinchisi ot bilan (sifat).

sentencePatterns.formula: No, it isn't + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + ISM's.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, it isn't hers. It's Claire's.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, uniki emas. Bu Kleyrniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Rad etish va haqiqiy egasini aytish.
Ikkalasida ham ot takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I think it's + ISM's. Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think it's Harold's. Yes, it's his.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, Haroldniki. Ha, uniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'I think' — taxminni yumshatadi. Keyin tasdiqlanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I haven't got one.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is this your football? — No, it isn't. I haven't got one.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu sening to'pingmi? — Yo'q. Menda yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'one' = 'a football' — otni takrorlamaslik uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's his/her job? — He's/She's a + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's her job? — She's a ballerina.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning kasbi nima? — U balerina.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlikda kasb oldida A/AN SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: What are their jobs? — They're + kasb (ko'plikda).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What are their jobs? — They're firefighters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning kasbi nima? — Ular o't o'chiruvchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plikda artikl YO'Q va 'jobs' ham ko'plikda.

sentencePatterns.formula: That's my + qarindoshlik. + EGALIK SIFATI + name's + ISM.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: That's my cousin. Her name's Wendy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mening amakivachcham. Uning ismi Vendi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ikkinchi gapda egalik sifati birinchi gapdagi odamga ishora qiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGALIK SIFATI + ot + is/are + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: His name is Jonathan. Their names are Julie and Laura.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning ismi Jonatan. Ularning ismi Juli va Lora.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega bo'lsa, ot ham fe'l ham ko'plikda: nameS ARE.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is this + ot + EGALIK OLMOSHI? — Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is this bicycle yours? — Yes, it's mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu velosiped seningmi? — Ha, meniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ikkala gapda ham ot takrorlanmaydi → egalik olmoshi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Whose + ot + is this? — It's + EGALIK OLMOSHI / ISM's.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whose guitar is this? — It's theirs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu gitara kimning? — Ularniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Whose' dan keyin ot, javobda esa otsiz olmosh.

sentencePatterns.formula: Fe'l (asos shakli) + davomi — buyruq.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Wake up. You're late! Look at her! Help me!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyg'on. Kechikding! Unga qara! Menga yordam ber!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Buyruqda ega yo'q. Ba'zi fe'llar predlog talab qiladi (look AT), ba'zilari yo'q (help me).

sentencePatterns.formula: Does + he/she + fe'l (asos) + ...? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Does he work at the local school? — No, he doesn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mahalliy maktabda ishlaydimi? — Yo'q, ishlamaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Javobdan savolni tiklash mumkin: 'he doesn't' → 'Does he ...?'

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + likes + ✓ + BUT + olmosh + doesn't like + ✗
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Theresa likes exercising but she doesn't like reading.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Teresa sport bilan shug'ullanishni yoqtiradi, lekin o'qishni yoqtirmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikkinchi qismda ISM o'rniga OLMOSH keladi.
3-shaxs birlikda: likes ... doesn't like.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + like/don't like + ✓ + BUT + olmosh + don't like + ✗
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They like football but they don't like tennis.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular futbolni yoqtiradi, lekin tennisni yoqtirmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega bilan: like ... don't like (-s YO'Q).

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + love/like/hate + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We love going to the cinema. They hate cleaning the house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz kinoga borishni juda yaxshi ko'ramiz. Ular uyni tozalashni yomon ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What does + ISM + look like? ↔ What's + ISM + like?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn:
What does Steve look like? — He's tall and very handsome.
What's your brother like? — He's kind and patient.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz:
Stiv qanday ko'rinadi? — U baland bo'yli va juda kelishgan.
Akang qanday odam? — U mehribon va sabrli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchisi TASHQI KO'RINISH ('look like' + DOES),
ikkinchisi XARAKTER ('be like' — 'does' kerak emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + fe'l+S (3-shaxs birlik tasdiq).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Michael lives in New York City. He goes every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Maykl Nyu-York shahrida yashaydi. U har kuni boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 3-shaxs birlikda -s. 'go' → 'goes' (-o → -es).

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + doesn't/don't + fe'l (asos shakli).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He doesn't work at a hospital. They don't watch TV in the evenings.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kasalxonada ishlamaydi. Ular kechqurunlari televizor ko'rmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Inkorda -s tushadi. 3-shaxs birlikda doesn't, qolganlarda don't.

sentencePatterns.formula: Does/Do + EGA + fe'l (asos shakli) + ... ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Does he work at a hospital? Do they watch TV in the evenings?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kasalxonada ishlaydimi? Ular kechqurunlari televizor ko'radimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolda ham -s tushadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: 'to be' bilan inkor va savol — do/does KERAK EMAS.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Their father isn't a firefighter. Is their father a firefighter?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning otasi o't o'chiruvchi emas. Ularning otasi o't o'chiruvchimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to be' o'zi yordamchi fe'l — u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 'not' oladi
va savolda oldinga chiqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + has/hasn't got + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has got short dark hair. Michael hasn't got any brothers or sisters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning sochi kalta va to'q rangli. Mayklning aka-uka va opa-singillari yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 3-shaxs birlikda 'has got'. Inkorda 'hasn't got' + ANY.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody wants TO BE + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He wants to be a professional basketball player.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U professional basketbolchi bo'lishni xohlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'want' dan keyin 'to' + fe'l. Kasb oldida 'a' shart.
